detail: Full summary: KEY ASYMMETRY for the design decision: file entity names ARE paths, so query('src/auth/') already matches 'src/auth/middleware.ts' by name regardless of the scope property — scope is redundant for files and currently wrong 45% of the time. Symbol entities have bare names ('computeGraphReachability') so scope is their only locator, though their decided_by relation to the decision entity already carries it. Any fix must answer files and symbols separately or accept redundancy on one side.
